item.name: Chat & Conversations (Archive & Deletion)
item.description: Production-ready APIs and Socket.IO real-time event specifications for conversation archive, Delete for Me, Delete for Everyone, and multi-device synchronization.

request.description: Hides a conversation from the requesting user's default chat list without deleting any messages or affecting other participants. Unpins if pinned. Synchronizes across user active devices via `conversation:archived` Socket.IO event.
Restores an archived conversation back to the requesting user's default active chat list.

Hides conversation for the requesting user only. Clears history cutoff (`clearedAt`), unpins, and notifies requesting user's active devices via `conversation:deleted` Socket.IO event. Other participants retain full history.

Globally deletes/hides conversation for all participants. Sets `isDeletedForEveryone: true`, unpins for all users, blocks new messages, and notifies all participants via `conversation:deleted` with `deleteType: 'everyone'`.
Fetches active, unarchived, non-deleted conversations partitioned into pinned and unpinned sections.
Fetches all archived conversations for the authenticated user.
Validates schema rejection when deleteType is not 'me' or 'everyone'.

Acknowledges receipt/delivery of messages on recipient device. Atomically transitions message status to 'delivered', sets server timestamp `deliveredAt`, and dispatches real-time `chat:delivery_receipt` / `message:delivery_receipt` to the message sender.

Synchronizes delivery status for pending or specified messages on the recipient device. Can be called with specific `messageIds`, an optional `conversationId`, or an empty body `{}` to acknowledge all pending undelivered messages for the user. Emits real-time `chat:delivery_receipt` / `message:delivery_receipt` to senders.

Marks incoming messages up to `lastReadMessageId` boundary as read by the recipient. Atomically sets `isRead: true`, `readAt: NOW()`, ensuring `isDelivered: true`. Emits `chat:read_receipt` to sender and syncs unread badge via `conversation:unread_updated`.

item.name: 10. Mark All Messages as Read (Omit Cursor)

request.description: Backwards-compatible read receipt: marks all currently unread incoming messages in the conversation as read when no cursor ID is provided.
Returns unread count for a specific conversation and the user's total aggregate unread messages badge count across all active conversations.
Initiates a one-to-one Agora RTC video call to the recipient user. Generates server-side channel name, caller UID, callee UID, short-lived RTC token, and notifies recipient via Socket.IO.
Recipient accepts the incoming ringing call. Atomically transitions status to accepted, returns callee RTC token, and notifies caller via Socket.IO.
Recipient rejects the incoming ringing call. Transitions status to rejected and notifies caller via Socket.IO.
Participant terminates ongoing or ringing video call. Idempotent.
Retrieves ongoing active call for current user with refreshed Agora RTC token.
Checks server health and database status.
Logs out authenticated user and optionally deactivates FCM device token.

request.description: Sends a message to one or multiple selected recipients (WhatsApp broadcast style). Creates/reuses individual 1-to-1 conversations, validates permissions independently, prevents self-messaging, provides idempotency protection, and dispatches real-time Socket.IO events.
Sends a text message with clientMessageId idempotency protection and real-time Socket.IO emission to the recipient's room.
Sends a voice note attachment (uploaded via /api/v1/media/presigned-url) with duration metadata.

item.name: 7b. Send Image via Direct Multipart Upload (Gallery / Camera File)

formdata.description: Image file from device gallery or camera (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF)

request.description: Directly uploads a photo/image file to AWS S3 and creates the chat message in a single request using multipart/form-data. Automatically generates thumbnail in S3, enriches metadata with public URLs, updates conversation preview to '📷 Photo', and emits real-time event.

formdata.description: Image file to upload to AWS S3

request.description: Dedicated S3 upload endpoint for chat media. Uploads image directly to AWS S3 under folder 'chat', generates thumbnail, and returns S3 key, publicUrl, mediaUrl, and thumbnailUrl. If called without a file, generates and returns an S3 presigned PUT URL.
Sends a camera-captured photo. Reuses the identical photo upload and message persistence pipeline without creating separate endpoints, tagging metadata with source: 'camera'.

Shares a selected location with validated latitude (-90..90) and longitude (-180..180). Canonical coordinates stored in metadata, content formatted to '📍 Union Square, SF', conversation preview updated to '📍 Union Square, SF'.

Shares a single selected contact card (name, phoneNumber, optional email). Strictly rejects bulk address-book dumps and unexpected properties, formats message content to '👤 Sarah Connor', and updates conversation preview to '👤 Sarah Connor'.
Marks all unread messages received in the conversation as read and emits real-time read receipt to the sender.
Pins a conversation for the authenticated user, causing it to appear in the pinned section of the Chat List screen.
Unpins a conversation for the authenticated user, restoring it to the standard conversation stream.
Triggered by the Chat Screen Action Menu ('View Profile'). Reuses the canonical profile-detail API to retrieve full profile details, bios, and photo galleries.

Triggered by the Chat Screen Action Menu ('Report Chat?'). Submits report using canonical user reporting endpoint with validation against the 4 UI modal reasons (spam, inappropriate_content, fake_profile, harassment) and optional conversationId with participant membership validation.

response.name: 400 Bad Request - Invalid Report Reason

request.description: Triggered by the Chat Screen Action Menu ('Block'). Reuses the canonical block endpoint to block the participant. Enforces restrictions across all chat listings, message streams, sending, and real-time socket events.
Unblocks a previously blocked user, restoring standard interaction permissions.
